item.title: Change a drink order
item.summary: A customer changes an order before paying.
item.transcript_text:
Server: One orange juice and two cheese rolls. Is that right?
Customer: The rolls are right, but can I have apple juice?
Server: Sure. Do you want to eat here?
Customer: No, I am taking everything to the park. Please put the rolls in a bag.
Server: Here you go. That is six pounds altogether.

options: Two friends are making a picnic list
A customer is checking a food order
A worker is closing a shop
A customer is asking for a refund
questions.explanation: The server repeats the order and the customer changes the juice.

questions.prompt: Which drink does the customer want?
questions.explanation: The customer asks for apple juice.

questions.prompt: How many rolls does the customer buy?
questions.explanation: The customer confirms two cheese rolls.
The customer says they are taking the food to the park.

questions.prompt: How much does the order cost?
questions.explanation: The server gives the total as six pounds.
